Description

Kuro in stock. Kuro+ preorders open now with shipping ETA in July

The K20C1 found in the 10th(FK8) and 11th(FL5) generation Honda Civic Type R as well as the latest DE5 Integra is a true powerhouse. A 2.0L 4-cylinder cranking out over 300+ whp and 300+ ft-lb of torque right off of the showroom floor, this engine is nothing to sleep on.



Most of this power comes from a factory-equipped MHI turbocharger that helps breathe life into the all-aluminum engine. However, as with all things from the OEM, it has its limits and it does not take too long to hit the ceiling of what it can do.

Years of research & development have led us to the creation of the first drop-in turbocharger from 27WON for the FK8 and FL5/DE5 platform. A 100% brand new unit with no core charge that was designed from the ground up. A specifically designed compressor wheel was used to maximize efficiency for its size. A 9-blade turbine wheel helps keep responsive spool characteristics and a BALL BEARING center section was selected for reliability to complete this premium turbo kit. We've had the ability to confirm fitment on all 2018+ Accord 2.0T models with some epic results as well.

Keep reading below to see what it takes to REDEFINE the Aftermarket.



You didn’t think we’d stop here, did you? Nah, that’s not our style so all new for this year is a 2nd version of this turbo called Kuro+. What’s all the this about? Well, how bout we took all we already knew about the original Kuro, incorporated dozens of your comments and feedback from years of use, and then built upon that with a bigger turbo that is responsive like no other.

So, how do you choose between the Kuro and Kuro+?

  • Kuro: Shooting for 500WHP or less? Possibly sticking with the stock fuel system? Just want a responsive turbo for more grunt and a healthy increase up top with no sacrifice to spool? This Kuro is for you!
  • Kuro+: Want to eclipse 500WHP+? For sure upgrading your fuel system components? Aiming for mid-range and top end punch while maintaining power down low? Kuro+ is the answer for you.
    • Note* Either of our Kuro turbos are going to be the most responsive and fastest spooling turbos out there compared to the rest. Be mindful of other “big turbos” that shoot for the moon, but are rarely fun to drive and really miss the mark when it comes to what a Type R or Type S Honda should feel like.



Kuro is Japanese for black and is the name given to the next generation of drop-in turbochargers from 27WON. We spent years silently working in the shadows to improve on our already successful formula for true 100% direct fitment turbochargers.

Kuro carries on the legacy of our most popular turbos for the L15 engine and multiplies and improves on it for the K20C1. Our target: to bring to you the best turbo system upgrade for your 2.0T Type R, Integra Type S, or AccordX.


There are two main ways to machine a compressor wheel: Flank-milled and Point-milled.

Flank-milled = is a cheaper and easier method of machining. You see this type of machine work on the OEM turbo of your FK8 and most aftermarket upgrades. It works well, but leaves a lot of performance on the table. Flank milled wheels are generally heavier and don't allow for as complex of designs to be achieved.

Point-milled = is a much more precise and expensive way to machine the wheel. By using individual tool paths during machining, much more complex designs and geometry can be obtained when creating this type of wheel.

Our team opted for an 8+0 count Point-milled wheel. This design moves more air than a split 6x6 design for a given size. The special cuts in the wheel face actually act as a scoop and help ingest more air than a flank-milled wheel. As well, this wheel is nearly 12% lighter than the flank-milled variety. The combination of more air and less weight helps improve transient response time for more power quicker off the shift.. The Kuro+ uses a different 9-blade compressor wheel configuration


We have a mantra here at 27WON and that is perfect OEM like fitment. It's in every product that we design and deliver and both our Kuro Type R turbocharger upgrades are no different. These Kuro units are 100% drop-in fitment turbos that bolt on just like the factory MHI unit. Water, oil feed, and oil return lines are all re-used and torque right on with zero issue. For Accord 2.0T owners, simply scroll down to our advisory notes and see the additional details you'll need for a seamless install.

Our subtle logo and serial number plate blend right in under the hood. This turbo upgrade retains all the factory heat-shields for a clean OEM like install. Those looking under your hood won't see what's coming to them.


Simply put, these 27WON drop-in turbos outperform the other big names out there. In the graph above, you see a direct comparison of the 27WON Kuro turbocharger "grey line" laid over the graph of the same car with another brand of drop-in turbocharger "green line".

With just a turbo swap and some fine-tuning we picked up both horsepower and torque over the ENTIRE RPM Range. Everything between 2000 and 7000 rpm saw an increase. At peak torque we saw gains of 34 wtq and at redline, we were able to carry 54 more whp than the competition. This is the power you can feel and it does not stop there. This was an FBO FK8 CTR car with street MAF and catted downpipe. Making the switch to a race MAF and catless downpipe allows for even more power to be had. And for a comparison of how the Kuro+ does, scroll through to the dyno images up at the very top.

right click on graph to open in new tab for larger image. For even more detailed power figure comparisons, see the "Read the Blogs" section right below.

High-grade Inconel is used to create the 9-blade turbine wheel for both Kuro turbochargers. This material is selected because it does two things really well.

First, Inconel has a unique ability to withstand extreme temperatures, both high and low. So, whether you are turning the car on the morning of a sub-zero degree day or you are rowing through the gears on track during a hot summer night, rest assured you have a material that has the ability to take it all.

Secondly, this material has great chemical resistance properties. There are a lot of additives and compounds in pump gas. Things like detergents and cleaners can have an effect on the metals in your engine. Using a material that can withstand this spectrum of chemicals is super important and is why we use this compound.


At the heart of either Kuro turbo is a TD04 ceramic ball bearing center housing and rotating assembly (CHRA). Your OEM turbocharger uses a standard journal-bearing (JB) oiling system. This is fine for stock and slightly over-stock power figures. However, as we increase both boost pressure and power output, we seek to maintain durability.

While a ball bearing CHRA can help improve spool in some cases its real benefit is in its increased reliability. A ball bearing (BB) unit requires less engine oil to circulate through the unit which means a BB turbo is less likely to experience any leaking or smoking issues. This means a trouble-free experience for you.

Also, a BB unit is able to take more sudden and abrupt loads than its JB counterpart. The angular contact of the actual balls in the bearing system means it can handle harder boost better. When you are cruising in 6th then drop to 3rd to pull on that Camaro trying to flex on you, the 27WON turbo can take all you throw at it.


Here is a side by side comparison of the 27WON Kuro turbocharger and the OEM FK8 MHI unit. Check out the break down below.

  • OEM compressor wheel inducer = 49mm
  • OEM compressor wheel exducer = 58mm
  • OEM turbine wheel inducer = 46.5mm
  • OEM turbine wheel exducer = 41.25mm

  • 27WON compressor wheel inducer = 50mm (54.2 mm for Kuro+)
  • 27WON compressor wheel exducer = 67mm
  • 27WON turbine wheel inducer = 52mm
  • 27WON turbine wheel exducer = 45.7mm (49.3mm for Kuro+)

These wheel sizes offer the perfect balance of increased horsepower and torque without being too large and losing the amazing responsiveness of the OEM turbo. Theses turbos will be at home both on the street and excel in time-attack and road racing environments.


100% brand new unit. No core exchange, no rebuilds, no downtime or waiting for machine work. The 27WON turbocharger utilizes high quality materials made from scratch for a unit that gives you that "new car smell."



No trips to the hardware store or asking to borrow your girlfriend's car. We ship this to your doorstep with everything you need for a complete and seamless install. New studs, gaskets, and stainless steel nuts to replace the old rusty hardware. Pair this hardware with our easy-to-use step-by-step digital instructions and you could almost do this install with your eyes closed.

The linear nature of this turbo upgrade makes it suitable for both daily driving, and high rpm blasts without any dead spots throughout the RPM range.

The Kuro has held up to commuting in bumper to bumper traffic with soaring heat, it's held up to track and autoX days, and most recently it's held up to a 2k mile road trip to Tail of the Dragon and back where I thrashed on the car for 3 days straight, at times holding the RPM above 5K in 2nd gear as we ascended massive hills.

Zero oil seepage, zero boost leaks, no wastegate rattle. I can't be any happier, it's still an occasion doing a 3-4 pull and being pinned to my seat!

Zero regrets, awaiting the arrival of my FL5 so I can install the Kuro on it as well!
